_comment: The 50-document HELD-OUT sample of the Part 3 dispatch segmentation. Drawn with a seeded generator (mulberry32, seed 4242) from the dispatch documents of the REBUILT corpus after the segmenter had been tuned on the 100-document sample (or27-dispatch-sample.json), read and labelled by hand BEFORE the segmenter was scored on it, and never used to tune it: its first score is the honest estimate of how the grammar generalises. Same field conventions as the 100-document sample (body, date, clock, place, to, signer; a null place or addressee is not checked, a null clock means the dispatch prints none, a null signer means no person signs it). A document that holds two dispatches has two truths; a dispatch whose heading is printed in a neighbouring document has a null date. after_id is the id the rebuilt corpus gave the document at drawing time. Because the documents are drawn from the rebuilt corpus, the sample measures the precision of its documents (merges, dangling lines, header fields), not the dispatches the rebuild might have swallowed or lost.
